description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorn and Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
